ios.desc:
Send messages to your future self!
 
Write a note. Pick a moment: a date, a time, or a place. HiFutureSelf delivers it exactly when you need it. Your grocery list as you walk into the store. A pep talk before the gym. A quiet "breathe" as you step out the door.
 
The simplest reminder app you'll ever use. And the most thoughtful.
 
*Celebrating 16 years on the App Store!*
 
 
WHAT YOU CAN SEND

• A note to yourself tomorrow, next month, or ten years from now.
• A voice memo recording for your future self.
• A photo, a face, a moment, a memory to land at the right time.
• A secret message to a friend. Surprise the people you love with a note that arrives exactly when they need it.
 

WHEN IT ARRIVES IS UP TO YOU
 
• Any future date and time, down to the minute.
• The moment you arrive at or leave a place.
• Hourly, daily, weekly, monthly, yearly, or on the specific days you choose.
• Pause anytime with a swipe. Resume the same way.
 
 
BUILT TO STAY OUT OF YOUR WAY
 
• 5 home screen widgets so your upcoming messages are always in view.
• Light and dark mode, matched to your iOS theme automatically.
• A library of motivational messages for the days the words won't come.
 
 
PRIVATE BY DESIGN
 
No accounts. No ads. No tracking. No in-app purchases. No data collection. Your messages live on your device, with optional iCloud sync. Works fully offline.
 
 
Download HiFutureSelf. Free. Start writing to the version of you who'll need it most.

quotes.text:
I've been working on HiFutureSelf slowly for the past 12 years.

And recently added a bunch of new features!

- Location based message trigger
- Share Extension, to allow you to pop text into HiFutureSelf
- Pause/Resume Repeating Messages (instead of having to delete them)
- Send Future Message invites to your friends

HiFutureSelf is free and does not have tracking or ads. I hope you enjoy it!

What do you think of it? How can I make HFS better for you?

Direct link to the App Store:
https://apps.apple.com/us/app/hifutureself-send-quick-messages/id384927725
